name: Exp_MAMA
summary: This EA trades based on the MAMA (Mesa Adaptive Moving Average) indicator crossover signals. It opens buy positions when the MAMA line crosses above the FAMA line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position sizing supports either fixed lot size or percentage-based money management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MAMA（Mesa自适应移动平均线）指标的交叉信号进行交易。当MAMA线上穿FAMA线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持固定手数或按资金比例计算。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用MAMA指标（Mesa自适应移动平均线）及其配套的FAMA线作为核心交易信号源。入场条件为：当Ma1（MAMA线）从下方穿越Ma2（FAMA线）时产生买入信号，当Ma1从上方穿越Ma2时产生卖出信号，采用典型的双线交叉策略判断趋势方向。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓（如持有多仓时出现卖出交叉信号则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位大小，但缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面，EA依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的交易算法函数来执行开平仓操作，止损止盈为固定点数而非基于ATR等动态指标。整体策略属于经典的趋势跟踪类型，逻辑简单清晰但缺乏对市场波动性和假突破的过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the MAMA (Mesa Adaptive Moving Average) indicator and its companion FAMA line as the core trading signal source. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when Ma1 (MAMA line) crosses above Ma2 (FAMA line), and a sell signal is generated when Ma1 crosses below Ma2, employing a classic dual-line crossover strategy to determine trend direction. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as reverse crossover signals triggering position closure (e.g., closing a long position when a sell crossover signal appears while holding long). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit percentage-based sizing, but lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms. In terms of money management, the EA relies on external trading algorithm functions from the included TradeAlgorithms.mqh file to execute opening and closing operations, with stop loss and take profit as fixed point values rather than dynamic indicators like ATR. The overall strategy falls into the classic trend following category, with simple and clear logic but lacking filters for market volatility and false breakouts.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade share; negative for fixed lots, positive for deposit ratio

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Max price slippage deviation in points

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于MAMA指标交叉信号易于理解和验证
提供了买卖开仓和平仓的独立开关，灵活控制交易方向
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
支持固定手数和资金比例两种仓位管理模式
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on MAMA crossover signals, easy to understand and verify
Independent switches for buy/sell opening and closing provide flexible trade direction control
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Supports both fixed lot size and deposit percentage position sizing modes
cons: 固定止损止盈不考虑市场波动性，在不同行情下可能不合适
缺乏假突破过滤机制，震荡行情中容易频繁止损
依赖外部自定义指标MAMA_Optim，可移植性和透明度受限
没有回撤控制或最大连亏保护机制
SignalBar=1可能导致信号延迟，而设为0又可能在未完成K线上产生虚假信号
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit don't account for market volatility, may be unsuitable across different market conditions
Lacks false breakout filtering, prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
Depends on external custom indicator MAMA_Optim, limiting portability and transparency
No drawdown control or maximum consecutive loss protection mechanism
SignalBar=1 may cause signal delay while setting it to 0 risks false signals on uncompleted bars
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，适应不同市场波动环境
增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），避免在横盘市中频繁交易
添加最大回撤保护和连亏限制机制
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt to varying market volatility
Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or volatility threshold) to avoid frequent trading in sideways markets
Add maximum drawdown protection and consecutive loss limit mechanisms

risk_points: 固定止损1000点在剧烈行情下可能不够，滑点风险存在
缺乏回撤控制，持续震荡市中可能反复止损累积亏损
MM参数负值模式下的固定手数没有账户资金保护
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss may be insufficient during volatile markets, slippage risk exists
Lacks drawdown control, repeated stop-outs in persistent ranging markets can accumulate losses
Fixed lot mode (negative MM values) has no account equity protection
